aiResearchSummary.text: Icertis is researching methods for representing documents using document keys, as described in 'Representing documents using document keys.' This work involves determining clause types within documents through classification models and assigning clause identifiers, aligning with the company's focus on AI-powered contract management. The research centers on document analysis and structured representation to support compliance and risk minimization.
